channel.description: Compare how India's media, left, centre and right, covers each story, side by side.

item.title: India and Kazakhstan Eye Deeper Trade and Investment Ties
item.description: India and Kazakhstan are seeking to strengthen their strategic partnership by fostering deeper trade and investment connections. Indian business organizations have welcomed the ratification of a free trade agreement with New Zealand… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Akamai and Anthropic Sign $11.6 Billion Cloud Services Deal
item.description: Akamai Technologies has signed a seven-year cloud services agreement with Anthropic valued at $11.6 billion. As part of the deal, Akamai will also grant Anthropic a warrant for up to a 5% stake in the company. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tesla Begins Deliveries of Semi Electric Trucks, Opens Nevada Factory
item.description: Tesla has begun deliveries of its Semi electric trucks and opened a new factory in Nevada to scale production of the heavy-duty vehicles. The company is commencing deliveries of the Semi, an electric truck designed for heavy-duty transport. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Costco Reports Increased Profit and Revenue
item.description: Costco reported higher profits and revenue for its fourth quarter, driven by resilient consumer spending. The company exceeded sales estimates, with demand remaining strong for essential goods. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sky TV announces content upgrade with JioHotstar integration
item.description: Sky TV has announced a significant upgrade for its Sky Q, Glass, and Stream boxes, integrating the JioHotstar content platform. This move will provide UK homes with access to more viewing options. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Argentina Poverty Rate Rises to 32.3% Under Milei
item.description: Argentina's poverty rate increased to 32.3% in the first half of 2026, up from 28.2% in the preceding six months, according to official data released on Thursday. Extreme poverty also rose to 7.5% from 6.3%. The data indicated that 44.5%… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Oracle Faces Claims Over Data Centre Payments
item.description: Oracle is facing scrutiny over its obligations to pay data centre investors, with questions arising about the company's ability to deliver on AI data centres. A 'force majeure' notice issued by Oracle has prompted these concerns. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: Global food prices have risen to a three-year high, driven by climate shocks and the war in Ukraine which have tightened supplies. The Economic Times reported that these factors are contributing to the increase. Separately, the Evening… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: EU asks UK to raise tariffs on Chinese cars
item.description: The European Union has urged the United Kingdom to increase tariffs on Chinese-made cars. This request is aimed at preventing the UK from imposing 'made in Europe' barriers. The Financial Times reported on the EU's appeal. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Microsoft launches data center region in Telangana
item.description: Microsoft has launched its India South Central data centre region in Telangana. This marks the company's expansion of its data infrastructure within India. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Kalpataru Projects Secures Orders Worth Over ₹2,000 Crore
item.description: Kalpataru Projects has announced securing new orders totaling ₹2,025 crore. These orders span across the Transmission & Distribution (T&D), buildings, and oil & gas sectors. The company's inflow for the fiscal year 2027 has reached ₹13,219… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: KKR-backed PMI Electro Mobility files confidential IPO papers
item.description: KKR-backed electric bus maker PMI Electro Mobility has confidentially filed initial public offering (IPO) papers in India. The company is backed by the investment firm KKR. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India plans for data center power load amid AI growth

item.title: Vascon Engineers Wins ₹660.79 Crore Order from Qualcomm
item.description: Vascon Engineers has secured a contract worth ₹660.79 crore from Qualcomm for a project involving their Bengaluru office. Following the announcement, Vascon Engineers' shares experienced a significant increase, zooming by 14%. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Adani Realty Plans Premium Housing Projects in Mumbai
item.description: Adani Realty is planning to launch premium and ultra-luxury residential projects in Mumbai. The company intends to develop these projects in Goregaon and Bandra, expanding its portfolio in the city and utilizing its land bank. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Waaree Group enters specialty gases market for chip manufacturing
item.description: Waaree Group has entered the specialty gases market with its new venture aiming to become a one-stop supplier of ultra-high purity gases for chip fabrication plants. The company's shares were in focus following this announcement. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Indian financial stocks experienced a significant selloff on Thursday, resulting in a market capitalisation erosion of ₹1.12 lakh crore. The decline was attributed to proposed changes by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: Bond yields are experiencing a sustained increase, driven by ongoing inflation fears that are keeping financial markets on edge. This rise in yields has led to a decline in stock prices, further exacerbated by higher oil prices. Financial… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 12 · Right 0.

item.description: Amid rising beef prices, some US restaurants are altering their menus. A Texas smokehouse has removed brisket from its offerings, while McDonald's is focusing on chicken to boost sales in the US market. The fast-food chain aims to increase… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) board has approved several reforms aimed at widening investment avenues and increasing Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) access. These reforms include allowing portfolio managers to invest… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: US Fed Officials Signal Further Rate Hikes Amid Inflation Concerns
item.description: Officials at the U.S. Federal Reserve believe interest rates will likely need to increase further to combat high inflation. A deputy governor at the Bank of England stated that a rate rise is becoming increasingly probable if energy prices… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: SoftBank raises $11.1 billion in bond sale for OpenAI investment
item.description: SoftBank's shares rose over 7% following the announcement of an $11.1 billion bond issuance. This issuance is intended to fund the company's investment in OpenAI and has been described as the world's largest high-yield corporate bond sale. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Treasury Yields Reach 2007 Highs, Worrying Investors
item.description: US Treasury yields have reached their highest levels since 2007, causing concern among investors. The rising bond rates are presenting a new challenge, with implications for the Federal Reserve. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.description: The United States and China have agreed to extend their trade truce by two months, with the agreement now set to last until January 10. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who is leading talks with China, announced the extension. The… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 7 · Right 2.

item.title: National Stock Exchange Lists on BSE, Shares See Modest Gains
item.description: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) made its debut as a listed company on the BSE, opening at ₹1,800 and closing at ₹1,818. The initial public offering (IPO) was valued at ₹22,561.57 crore, making it the second-largest in Indian history. NSE… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 8 · Right 1.

item.title: Meta's New AI Agent Sparks Market Reaction and Criticism
item.description: Meta has launched a new artificial intelligence agent that has caused a stir in the stock market, affecting shares of banks, insurers, and travel companies. The AI agent has been met with both enthusiasm and backlash, with its rapid… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Canadian Dollar, Sterling Decline Against US Dollar
item.description: The Canadian dollar reached a two-month low following a monthly decline in retail sales. Separately, the British pound fell to its lowest point in nearly three months against the US dollar. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Oil Prices Surge Amid Houthi Attacks and Geopolitical Tensions
item.description: Oil prices increased by 2% following attacks by Houthi militants, which have raised concerns about supply disruptions. The situation is further complicated by fears of escalation between the U.S. and Iran. These events have contributed to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Reliance Industries plans $1 billion debt fundraise
item.description: Reliance Industries is planning to raise approximately ₹10,000 crore, which is about $1.04 billion, through the sale of 10-year notes. The annual coupon rate for these notes is expected to be 7.90%, according to merchant bankers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bangladesh Resumes Indian Wheat Purchases Amid Supply Disruptions
item.description: Bangladesh has resumed purchasing wheat from India, a move prompted by disruptions in Black Sea supplies. This resumption of trade comes as high rice prices in Bangladesh are reportedly leading consumers to opt for roti (flatbread)… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: A report on Assam's startup ecosystem indicates robust entrepreneurial participation across various sectors. According to the IIMCIP's Assam Startup Ecosystem Report, 52.6% of surveyed startups were founded by women. However, the report… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
